symbols.name: Delivery
symbols.docs: Delivery is a verified delivery and its event.

members.name: WebhookID
members.docs: WebhookID is the delivery's webhook-id. It stays the same when a delivery is retried; use it to discard duplicates.

members.name: Timestamp
members.docs: Timestamp is the delivery's webhook-timestamp, in Unix seconds.

symbols.name: Error
symbols.docs: Error is a delivery that failed verification. Its message never contains secrets, signatures or the body.

members.name: Code
members.docs: Code is why the delivery failed.

members.name: Message
members.docs: Message is a human-readable diagnostic.

members.name: Is
members.docs: Is reports whether target is the error's `Code`.

symbols.name: Event
signatures:
type Event struct {
	EventID      string
	EventType    string
	OccurredAt   string
	ProjectID    string
	SubjectRef   SubjectRef
	Known        bool
	Notification *Notification
}
symbols.docs: Event is a verified delivery's metadata-only event envelope.

members.name: OccurredAt
members.docs: OccurredAt is when the event happened (RFC 3339).

members.name: SubjectRef
members.docs: SubjectRef names the resource the event is about.

members.name: Known
members.docs: Known reports whether this SDK knows the event type. Acknowledge an event it doesn't know, including a notification event that doesn't match the push payload contract.

members.name: Notification
members.docs: Notification is the event's fields when it is a known notification event, and nil otherwise.

symbols.name: Notification
signatures:
type Notification struct {
	EventID        string     `json:"eventId"`
	EventType      string     `json:"eventType"`
	OccurredAt     string     `json:"occurredAt"`
	ProjectID      string     `json:"projectId"`
	SubjectRef     SubjectRef `json:"subjectRef"`
	RecipientID    string     `json:"recipientId"`
	ConversationID string     `json:"conversationId"`
	SenderID       string     `json:"senderId"`
	Connected      bool       `json:"connected"`
	MessageID      string     `json:"messageId,omitempty"`
	Preview        *Preview   `json:"preview,omitempty"`
	LiveSessionID  string     `json:"liveSessionId,omitempty"`
	AlertID        string     `json:"alertId,omitempty"`
	ExpiresAt      string     `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
	MediaProfile   string     `json:"mediaProfile,omitempty"`
	Reason         string     `json:"reason,omitempty"`
}
symbols.docs: Notification is a per-recipient notification event: a message for the recipient, an incoming call, or a call that stopped ringing for the recipient. It is the input of the push package's builders. The contract is spec/push-payload in the SDK repository.

members.name: EventType
members.docs: EventType is EventNotificationMessage, EventNotificationCall or EventNotificationCallCancelled.

members.name: OccurredAt
members.docs: OccurredAt is when the message was sent, the ring started or the ring stopped (RFC 3339).

members.name: RecipientID
members.docs: RecipientID is the principal to notify. Each recipient gets its own event.

members.name: SenderID
members.docs: SenderID is the principal who sent the message or started the ringing.

members.name: Connected
members.docs: Connected reports whether the recipient had an active realtime connection when the event was produced. It is a hint for your sending policy: it isn't per device, and it can change before you send. The push builders ignore it.

members.name: MessageID
members.docs: MessageID names the message of a message event.

members.name: Preview
members.docs: Preview is the start of a message event's text, present only when the project opts in to previews and the message has text.

members.name: LiveSessionID
members.docs: LiveSessionID names the call of a call or cancellation event.

members.name: AlertID
members.docs: AlertID names the ring. A later ring of the same call has a new AlertID; a cancellation carries the stopped ring's.

members.name: ExpiresAt
members.docs: ExpiresAt is when the ring stops if nobody answers (RFC 3339). A cancellation carries the stopped ring's original deadline.

members.name: MediaProfile
members.docs: MediaProfile is the call's media profile, such as MediaProfileAudioOnly.

members.name: Reason
members.docs: Reason is why a cancellation's ring stopped, such as ReasonEnded.

members.name: Validate
members.docs: Validate checks n against the push payload contract. It returns an error that names the first invalid field without its value. It ignores the fields the contract doesn't define for n's event type.

symbols.name: Preview
symbols.docs: Preview is the start of a message's text.

members.name: Text
members.docs: Text is 1 to 512 Unicode code points.

members.name: Truncated
members.docs: Truncated reports whether the message text continues after Text.

symbols.name: Signature
symbols.docs: Signature is a verified delivery's identity.

members.name: WebhookID
members.docs: WebhookID is the delivery's webhook-id. It stays the same when a delivery is retried; use it to discard duplicates.

members.name: Timestamp
members.docs: Timestamp is the delivery's webhook-timestamp, in Unix seconds.

symbols.name: SubjectRef
symbols.docs: SubjectRef names a resource.

symbols.name: Code
symbols.docs:
Code is why a delivery failed verification. Code implements error so that errors.Is(err, CodeTimestampExpired) matches an `*Error` with that code.

Verification failure codes. Checks run in the order listed and stop at the first failure.

members.name: CodeInvalidSecret
members.docs: CodeInvalidSecret means no secret is given, or one is not whsec\_ followed by padded standard Base64 of 24 to 64 bytes. It is your configuration, not the sender.

members.name: CodeMissingHeader
members.docs: CodeMissingHeader means webhook-id, webhook-timestamp or webhook-signature is absent or empty.

members.name: CodeInvalidHeader
members.docs: CodeInvalidHeader means one of those headers is repeated.

members.name: CodeInvalidTimestamp
members.docs: CodeInvalidTimestamp means webhook-timestamp is not 1 to 15 ASCII digits (integer Unix seconds).

members.name: CodeTimestampExpired
members.docs: CodeTimestampExpired means the timestamp is more than the tolerance before now.

members.name: CodeTimestampFuture
members.docs: CodeTimestampFuture means the timestamp is more than the tolerance after now.

members.name: CodeBodyTooLarge
members.docs: CodeBodyTooLarge means the body exceeds 4096 bytes.

members.name: CodeTooManySignatures
members.docs: CodeTooManySignatures means webhook-signature has more than 8 entries.

members.name: CodeNoMatchingSignature
members.docs: CodeNoMatchingSignature means no v1 signature matches any secret.

members.name: CodeInvalidBody
members.docs: CodeInvalidBody means the signed body is not a UTF-8 JSON event envelope. Only `Verify` reports it.

members.name: Error
members.docs: Error returns the code as an error message.

symbols.name: Option
symbols.docs: Option configures verification.

symbols.name: Verify
signatures: func Verify(body []byte, header http.Header, secrets []string, options ...Option) (Delivery, error)
symbols.docs: Verify verifies a delivery's signature and timestamp, then parses its event. Pass the body exactly as received and the request's headers. The delivery is valid when any v1 signature matches any of secrets, the endpoint's whsec\_ secrets: the current one and, during a rotation, the other. A failed delivery returns an `*Error`; an invalid option returns another error.

symbols.name: VerifySignature
signatures: func VerifySignature(body []byte, header http.Header, secrets []string, options ...Option) (Signature, error)
symbols.docs: VerifySignature verifies only a delivery's signature and timestamp, for bodies you parse yourself. It fails like `Verify`, except that it never reports `CodeInvalidBody`.

symbols.name: WithClock
symbols.docs: WithClock replaces time.Now. Use it in tests.

symbols.name: WithTolerance
symbols.docs: WithTolerance sets the allowed distance between a delivery's webhook-timestamp and now, inclusive. It must be a non-negative whole number of seconds. The default is `DefaultTolerance`.

symbols.name: DefaultTolerance
symbols.docs: DefaultTolerance is the default allowed distance between a delivery's webhook-timestamp and the verifier's clock.

symbols.name: ReasonAnswered
symbols.docs:
ReasonAnswered means the recipient answered, on any device.

Why a ring stopped, in `Notification`.Reason. Treat a reason you don't know as "stop ringing", without a missed-call alert.

symbols.name: ReasonDeclined
symbols.docs:
ReasonDeclined means the recipient declined, on any device.

Why a ring stopped, in `Notification`.Reason. Treat a reason you don't know as "stop ringing", without a missed-call alert.

symbols.name: ReasonEnded
symbols.docs:
ReasonEnded means the call ended or stopped ringing before the recipient answered: a missed call.

Why a ring stopped, in `Notification`.Reason. Treat a reason you don't know as "stop ringing", without a missed-call alert.

symbols.name: ReasonExpired
symbols.docs:
ReasonExpired means nobody answered by ExpiresAt: a missed call.

Why a ring stopped, in `Notification`.Reason. Treat a reason you don't know as "stop ringing", without a missed-call alert.
